description: This file defines middleware and helper functions for tenant-scoped filtering in a MongoDB/Mongoose context, including functions to filter objects, queries, and aggregations based on tenant ID, as well as middleware to attach tenant info to requests.

methods.name: isMongooseQuery
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Mongoose query by verifying presence of 'where' or 'find' functions.

methods.name: filterObject
methods.description: Adds tenant_id to an object if not already present, based on tenantId.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Adds a tenant_id filter to a Mongoose query if not already set, considering request context.

methods.name: applyToAggregation
methods.description: Prepends a $match stage with tenant_id to an aggregation pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: stampCreate
methods.description: Sets tenant_id on a document if missing, respecting global/all-tenants mode.

methods.name: tenantScope
methods.description: Express middleware that attaches tenant filtering helpers and info to the request object, with super admin bypass logic.
